description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Devin White (healthy scratch) is inactive for the Lions game against the Panthers.
items.impact: White used to be a tackling machine, but has struggled to find the field over the last few years. He has had limited snaps for Detroit over the first two weeks, but will now be inactive for the second straight week.
items.title: Devin White (healthy scratch) inactive against Panthers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice is questionable to return against the Raiders with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Rice suffered the injury after a reception and hobbled off the field. Fantasy managers should expect the team to provide an update after halftime.
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring) questionable to return

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot, rib) is expected to play on Sunday against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Ladd is battling through several injuries right now, but he is expected to push through them and play. The Chargers offense desperately needs him, because without him, the offense is unable to move the ball effectively.
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) expected to play on Sunday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jalen Coker (quad) is inactive for the Panthers game against the Lions on Sunday night.
items.impact: With Coker out due to his quad injury, Tetairoa McMillan and Darren Waller will operate as the primary one-two for the Carolina passing game. Brycen Tremayne is a sneaky flex start as he will operate as the Panthers WR2.
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) inactive on Sunday against Lions

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Bills D/ST allowed 269 passing yards, 143 rushing yards, and 29 points in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: The Bills' defense tallied one sack, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the loss Sunday. Despite the two turnovers, the Bills could not stop a late comeback by Drake Maye in the Patriots. The Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.
items.title: Bills D/ST allows 29 points in Week 4 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Tyler Bass connected on both of his field goal attempts and both extra point attempts in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Bass connected on field goal attempts of 27 and 38 yard field goals in the loss to New England. Bass is 6-for-6 on field goal attempts and has missed on extra point so far this season. Bass and the Bills will head on the road to take on the Rams in Week 5.
items.title: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 4

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid caught 1-of-2 targets for seven yards in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Kincaid set new season lows in all receiving metrics in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers will hope that Kincaid bounces back in a Week 5 matchup against the Rams.
items.title: Dalton Kincaid quiet in Week 4

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Keon Coleman caught 6-of-7 targets for 116 yards and a touchdown in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Coleman found the end zone for the first time this season on a 34-yard touchdown reception in the fourth quarter. Coleman set a new season high in yardage and targets in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers could see Coleman become a bigger part of the offense heading into Week 5 after this performance.
items.title: Keon Coleman hauls in a touchdown in Week 4

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Khalil Shakir caught 7-of-8 targets for 82 yards in the Bills loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Shakir led the team in receptions and targets in the loss Sunday. All three marks are new season highs for Shakir, a potential positive sign for fantasy managers that have rostered him in a tough season. Shakir and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.
items.title: Khalil Shakir hauls in seven passes in Week 4

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Ty Johnson rushed for three yards on one carry in the loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for nine yards.
items.impact: Johnson continues to operate as the change of pace back, but has limited fantasy value right now. Fantasy managers can leave Johnson on the waiver wire heading into a matchup with the Rams.
items.title: Ty Johnson sees three touches in Week 4

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: James Cook III rushed for 75 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for eight yards.
items.impact: Cook averaged 6.3 yards per carry on his 12 carries, providing the Bills with an incredibly efficient effort. Despite the strong performance, his 12 rushing attempts are a new season low. Cook and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.
items.title: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 4

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passes for 254 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the loss to the Patriots. He rushed for four yards and a touchdown on five carries.
items.impact: Allen turned in a solid day Sunday, including a touchdown pass to Keon Coleman late in the game. Allen was without DJ Moore, who left the game in the first half with a shoulder injury. His interception late in the game ended up a comeback and handed the Bills their first loss of the season. Allen and the Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.
items.title: Josh Allen accounts for two touchdowns in Week 4 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Patriots D/ST allowed 253 passing yards, 91 rushing yards, and 26 points in a win over the Bills.
items.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied one sack, one fumble recovery, and one interception in the win Sunday. The interception was on the final drive for the Bills, helping the Patriots seal their second win of the season. The Patriots will take on the Raiders in Week 5.
items.title: Patriots D/ST allows 26 points in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Andy Borregales made all three of his extra point attempts in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Borregales was not called upon to attempt any field goals in the win Sunday. The second-year kicker is 5-for-7 on field goal attempts and 6-for-6 on extra point attempts so far this season.
items.title: Andy Borregales perfect in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Hunter Henry caught all five of his targets for 62 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Henry led the team in receiving yards, and caught the pass to seal the win late in the fourth quarter. His five receptions and 62 yards mark new season highs for the veteran. Henry will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.
items.title: Hunter Henry hauls in five passes in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Efton Chism III caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Chism made an impressive 23-yard touchdown reception late in the fourth quarter to give the Patriots the lead and the win Sunday. His two receptions and 42 yards establish new season highs, but Chism could be asked to do more in Week 5 if Mack Hollins (calf) is unable to suit up against Las Vegas.
items.title: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: DeMario Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Douglas continues to see limited targets in the Patriots' offense. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable leaving him on the waiver wire heading into Week 5.
items.title: DeMario Douglas held to two receptions in Week 4

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Mack Hollins caught 3-of-4 targets for 53 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Hollins continues to excel in his role as a chain mover, but the veteran did exit the game with a calf injury. Fantasy managers will want to monitor his status heading into a Week 5 matchup with the Raiders.
items.title: Mack Hollins hauls in three passes in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Romeo Doubs caught 6-of-9 targets for 58 yards and two touchdowns in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Doubs caught passes of two and 14 yards to account for two of Drake Maye's three touchdown passes on the day. This was easily Doubs' best day as a Patriot. Fantasy managers should expect Doubs to continue to see plenty of targets heading into a Week 5 matchup with Las Vegas.
items.title: Romeo Doubs hauls in two touchdowns in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson rushed for 42 yards on 14 carries in the Patriots win over the Bills. He did not record a reception on his two targets.
items.impact: Henderson saw just one more carry that Rhamondre Stevenson, but failed to do much on his 14 touches. Fantasy managers should expect Stevenson and Henderson to continue to split time in the backfield in Week 5 against Las Vegas.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson sees 14 touches in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed for 47 yards and a touchdown on 13 carries in the Patriots win over the Bills. He caught 3-of-5 targets for 27 yards.
items.impact: Stevenson found the end zone on a one-yard plunge in the second-quarter. Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson split time in the backfield, and fantasy managers should expect more of the same against the Raiders in Week 5.
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson sees 16 touches in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Drake Maye completed 22-of-37 passes for 269 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Bills. He added 54 rushing yards on eight carries, while losing one fumble.
items.impact: Maye led the Patriots to a comeback win on the road against the Bills, despite struggling again with some turnovers. The former first-round pick was able to find Efton Chism on a 23-yard pass to give the team the lead with under two minutes remaining. He will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.
items.title: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Ravens D/ST allowed 222 passing yards, 85 rushing yards, and 18 points in a win over the Titans.
items.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied one, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. The Titans' offense was finally able to start breaking through in the second half, but the game appeared well in hand at that point. The Ravens will travel to Atlanta in Week 5.
items.title: Ravens D/ST allows 18 points in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in the Ravens win over the Titans.
items.impact: Loop connected on a 64-yard field goal attempt to close out the first half. He would later miss a 40-yard attempt late in the fourth quarter. Loop is 6-for-8 so far on field goal attempts this season.
items.title: Tyler Loop makes 64-yard field goal in Week 4 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Mark Andrews caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens win over the Titans.
items.impact: Andrews caught a three-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to extend the Ravens' lead. This marked the veteran's first trip to the end zone this season. Andrews will look to build on this performance against the Falcons in Week 5.
items.title: Mark Andrews finds the end zone in Week 4 win
